domain.name: State Chart XML Questionnaire
domain.summary: Questionnaire-first domain for constructing branching surveys, interviews, and guided workflows while generating valid W3C State Chart XML (.scxml). Users model questions, answer data, linear flow, conditional branches, split points, and convergence points; low-level SCXML definitions remain available as advanced generated-output support.
domain.description: This domain presents questionnaire concepts as the primary modeling surface and treats SCXML as the target output language. Model flat questionnaires by binding questions to answer variables, or model nested/complex questionnaires with data objects, data fields, sections, groups, and repeat groups. Branches can split from questions, decisions, or choice options and converge through branch merge nodes or shared next questions.
domain.techSpec:
questionnaireModel: questionnaire-first
outputLanguage: SCXML
scxmlVersion: 1.0
answerEvent: answer.submit
branching: linear, conditional, split, converge
dataModel: flat variables or nested object/field concepts

conceptDefinitions.name: <assign>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Action that updates a datamodel location.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <assign>. Use fields for simple location/expr assignments; use SCXML_Assigns_Data and SCXML_Computes_Expression when the data mutation or expression should be visible in diagrams.

conceptDefinitions.name: <cancel>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Action that cancels a delayed or pending send.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <cancel>. It cancels an outstanding send by sendid or sendidexpr and is normally contained in onentry, onexit, transition, finalize, or conditional executable content.

conceptDefinitions.name: <content>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Inline or expression-based payload for send, invoke, or done-data.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <content>. Use it for inline payload bodies or expression-produced payloads. It may be contained by send, invoke, done-data, or modeled event payload structures.

conceptDefinitions.name: Custom Executable Content
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Extension executable action from a non-SCXML namespace.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents an extension executable element outside the standard SCXML namespace. Use namespaceUri, localName, rawAttributes, and bodyXml to preserve the extension payload.

conceptDefinitions.name: Data Expression
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Reusable or visually explained expression used by guards, assignments, or payloads.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Use this helper for complex or reused expressions. Simple one-off conditions and expressions can stay on the owning SCXML element field.

conceptDefinitions.name: Data Reference
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Helper node for an explicit datamodel reference or path.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Use this helper when a datamodel path or reference deserves its own visible node. Direct relationships to SCXML_Data are preferred for simple dependencies.

conceptDefinitions.name: Data Scope
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Design-time grouping for data by document, state, or local scope.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Use this design-time helper to group data by document, state, parallel, local, or external scope. It is not normally emitted as standard SCXML.

conceptDefinitions.name: Data Value
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Visible inline value or payload object used to initialize data.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Use this helper when a data item has a large or structured initial value that should be visible separately from the <data> node.

conceptDefinitions.name: <data>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. SCXML data item whose id comes from the idea TechName.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents a <data> item. The SCXML id should come from Idea.TechName after XML-id normalization; initialization comes from src, expr, inlineValue, or explicit value/expression nodes.

conceptDefinitions.name: <datamodel>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Container for SCXML data declarations.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <datamodel>. It contains <data> declarations and is normally contained by the SCXML document or a state-like context.

conceptDefinitions.name: <scxml>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Root SCXML document that owns the state machine and document-level settings.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents the root <scxml> element. Its Idea Name supplies the SCXML name attribute; document-level details provide version, xmlns, datamodel, and binding. It contains top-level states, parallel states, final states, and optional datamodel content.

conceptDefinitions.name: Done Event
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Completion event produced by final states, invokes, or document completion.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents completion events such as done.state.* or invoke completion. Use SCXML_Produces_Done_Event when the emitting source should be visible.

conceptDefinitions.name: <donedata>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Payload block emitted when a final state completes.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <donedata>. It is used inside <final> to provide completion payloads and usually contains <param> and/or <content>.

conceptDefinitions.name: <else>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Fallback branch inside an <if> block.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <else>. It belongs inside an <if> structure and contains fallback executable content when no earlier branch matches.

conceptDefinitions.name: <elseif>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Additional conditional branch inside an <if> block.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <elseif>. It belongs inside an <if> structure and can contain executable content for that conditional branch.

conceptDefinitions.name: Error Event
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Error event used for recovery transitions and failure modeling.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents error events such as error.execution or error.communication. Use it to connect failure sources to recovery transitions.

conceptDefinitions.name: Event Descriptor
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Raw SCXML event descriptor or pattern used by transition triggers.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents transition event descriptors and patterns such as exact names, prefix matches, wildcards, or lists. Export transition event attributes from this node when modeled.

conceptDefinitions.name: Event Payload
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Explicit modeled payload, schema, or sample carried by an event.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Design-time helper for event payload schema, sample data, or message body. Use SCXML_Event_Carries_Payload to attach it to modeled events.

conceptDefinitions.name: Event
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Generic modeled event used when a more specific event type is not needed.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Generic event concept for shared event identity. Use Internal, External, Done, or Error Event definitions when queue/source/completion/error semantics matter.

conceptDefinitions.name: External Event
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Event received from or sent to an external source.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents events exchanged with users, services, devices, invoked sessions, or other systems. Use with send/receive relationships and I/O processor hints.

conceptDefinitions.name: External Service
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Modeled external system, service, or SCXML machine that may be invoked.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Design-time helper for external systems, services, actors, queues, or other SCXML machines. It is a target for invoke modeling and is not emitted as standard SCXML unless a template maps it.

conceptDefinitions.name: <final>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Final state that completes its parent state or document.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents a <final> state. Use it to mark completion of a compound state or the whole document. Completion semantics can be made explicit with SCXML_Completes and SCXML_Produces_Done_Event.

conceptDefinitions.name: <finalize>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Executable block that handles returned data before invoke completion is processed.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <finalize>. It is composable and contains executable content that runs when an invoked process returns data before the parent machine handles the returned event.

conceptDefinitions.name: <foreach>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Executable-content loop over a collection expression.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <foreach>. Use array, item, and optional index fields for loop setup; contained executable content is the loop body.

conceptDefinitions.name: <history>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. History pseudo-state that recalls a previous active configuration.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents a <history> pseudo-state. It records a previous active configuration and can point to a fallback target with SCXML_History_Defaults_To when no history exists.

conceptDefinitions.name: <if>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Conditional executable-content container.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <if>. It is composable and may contain executable content, <elseif>, and <else> branches. The cond field holds the primary condition.

conceptDefinitions.name: <initial>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Initial pseudo-state or default entry point for a compound state.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents an <initial> pseudo-state or a visualized state initial attribute. It normally contains exactly one transition and can be linked to the default target with SCXML_Default_Initial.

conceptDefinitions.name: Internal Event
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Event raised or generated inside the SCXML session.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents events raised or generated inside the SCXML session. <raise> actions and generated done/error behavior can link to this concept when event identity matters.

conceptDefinitions.name: Invocation Result
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Modeled event or payload returned from an invocation.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Design-time helper for result events or payloads produced by an invocation. Use when return data needs to be visible or linked to data handling.

conceptDefinitions.name: <invoke>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. SCXML invocation that starts an external process or nested SCXML session.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <invoke>. It starts an invoked session, service, or process. Use SCXML_Invokes_Service for modeled targets, contained params/content for input, and <finalize> for return handling.

conceptDefinitions.name: <log>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Diagnostic action that emits a label/expression.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <log>. Use it for trace output and diagnostics; data and expression relationships may be used when the logged value matters in the model.

conceptDefinitions.name: <onentry>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Executable-content block that runs when its parent state is entered.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents an <onentry> block. It should contain executable-content children through SCXML_Contains, and those children execute when the owning state is entered.

conceptDefinitions.name: <onexit>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Executable-content block that runs when its parent state is exited.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents an <onexit> block. It should contain executable-content children through SCXML_Contains, and those children execute when the owning state is exited.

conceptDefinitions.name: <parallel>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Parallel state whose child states are active concurrently.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents a <parallel> state. Its child states are simultaneously active while the parallel state is active. Use SCXML_Contains to model child regions/states and contained executable content.

conceptDefinitions.name: <param>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Named parameter used by send, invoke, or done-data payloads.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <param>. Use with <send>, <invoke>, and <donedata> to model name/value payload parameters.

conceptDefinitions.name: <raise>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Action that raises an internal SCXML event.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <raise>. Use the event field for simple models, or SCXML_Raises_Event when the raised internal event is modeled as an Event concept.

conceptDefinitions.name: <script>
conceptDefinitions.summary: Advanced generated SCXML support. Inline or external script execution block.
conceptDefinitions.description:
Advanced/generated SCXML support definition. Use questionnaire-first concepts for normal modeling; this definition remains available for low-level SCXML compatibility.

Represents <script>. Use src for external script files or scriptBody for inline script text. Keep platform-specific script semantics in descriptions or TechSpec.
